name: bitwarden-secure-sync
description: A simple tool that can be used to export your Bitwarden vault to a local file periodically. Uses the Bitwarden CLI tool to communicate with the API, and exports your passwords using the default Bitwarden export method.

paths.name: Configuration directory
paths.description: The configuration directory used for setting up the application. A default appsettings.json file will be created in this directory upon inital run, after which it will require further manual configuration.

paths.name: Data directory
paths.description: The default data directory used by the application. By default, the Bitwarden CLI will export your data here.
